mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE DATE(r_start_time)=CURDATE() AND r_status!='CANCELLED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE DATE(r_start_time)=DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND r_status!='CANCELLED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE u_active=0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE YEAR(u_created)=YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(u_created)=MONTH(CURDATE()) AND u_active=0
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(r_total_price),0) FROM reservation WHERE YEAR(r_start_time)=YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(r_start_time)=MONTH(CURDATE()) AND r_status!='CANCELLED'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s_idx) FROM reservation WHERE r_start_time <= NOW() AND r_end_time >= NOW() AND r_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','PENDING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiries WHERE i_active = 1 AND i_status = '대기중'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r_start_time,'%Y-%m') AS month, IFNULL(SUM(r_total_price),0) AS revenue FROM reservation WHERE r_start_time >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 5 MONTH),'%Y-%m-01') AND r_status!='CANCELLED' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r_start_time,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT s.s_name AS spacename, COUNT(r.r_idx) AS usagecount FROM reservation r JOIN space s ON r.s_idx=s.s_idx WHERE r.r_start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AND r.r_status!='CANCELLED' GROUP BY s.s_idx, s.s_name ORDER BY usagecount DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT WEEK(r_start_time)-WEEK(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01'))+1 AS weeknum, DAYOFWEEK(r_start_time) AS dayofweek, COUNT(*) AS reservecnt FROM reservation WHERE YEAR(r_start_time)=YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(r_start_time)=MONTH(CURDATE()) AND r_status!='CANCELLED' GROUP BY weeknum, DAYOFWEEK(r_start_time) ORDER BY weeknum, DAYOFWEEK(r_start_time)

SELECT r.r_idx AS res_idx, u.u_name AS user_name, s.s_name AS spc_name, DATE_FORMAT(r.r_start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') AS res_date, r.r_status AS res_status, r.r_total_price AS res_price FROM reservation r JOIN user u ON r.u_idx=u.u_idx JOIN space s ON r.s_idx=s.s_idx ORDER BY r.r_created DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT u_idx AS user_idx, u_name AS user_name, u_email AS user_email, u_created AS user_created FROM user WHERE u_active=0 ORDER BY u_created DESC LIMIT 5
